# Design System: Bright Cargo look (v1)

A look chosen in the Designer for this app.

This project follows the **Bright Cargo look** design system in **advisory** mode. Generated files are the source of truth for colours, typography and shape; never edit them by hand.

## Files
- `src/styles/design-tokens.css` — CSS variables (light and dark) in shadcn/ui naming. Import it from the root stylesheet.
- `tailwind.design-system.preset.ts` — Tailwind preset; add `presets: [designSystemPreset]` to `tailwind.config.ts`.
- `.cdf/design-system/tokens.json` — machine-readable tokens for non-Tailwind stacks.
- `public/brand/` — logo and font assets served at `/brand/<file>`.

## Colours
Always use semantic classes (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`) or brand palette classes (`bg-brand-<key>`). Hard-coded hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()` and Tailwind default colour families such as `bg-blue-500` are **forbidden** and fail the adherence check.

Contrast policy: WCAG AA (4.5:1) is required for every text pair.

## Typography
- sans: **Rounded** (system, weights 400/500/600/700)
- display: **Geometric** (system, weights 600/700/800)
- mono: **JetBrains Mono** (system)

Text styles:
- h1: `text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight`
- h2: `text-xl font-semibold`
- h3: `text-lg font-semibold`
- body: `text-sm`
- muted: `text-sm text-muted-foreground`

## Shape and spacing
- Radius: sm 18px, md 22px, lg 26px, pills 9999px
- Shadows: strong; density: comfortable
- Spacing base 4px; page padding `px-4 py-8`; section gap `space-y-8`
- Icons: lucide at stroke width 1.75

## Logos and brand assets
- No logo assets supplied

Do not:
- (none recorded)

## Components
Components come from shadcn/ui. Use its primitives (Button, Dialog, Input, Select, Table, Card) styled through the semantic tokens; do not reimplement them.

Rules:
- **Button** (required): Use the shadcn Button with semantic variants; never introduce custom colours on buttons.
- **Dialog** (required): Use the shadcn Dialog for modals; no hand-rolled overlays.
- **Form** (advisory): Every input has a visible Label and an error message slot.


## Voice and copy
- Use sentence case for headings and buttons.
- Tone: clear, direct.
- (no glossary)

## Working with the design system
- Call `design_system({ action: "tokens" })` for the resolved colours, `design_system({ action: "assets" })` for logo paths, `design_system({ action: "rules" })` for component rules, and `design_system({ action: "check" })` to run the adherence check before finishing UI work.
- When the adherence check reports findings, fix them in the same task. Suppress a single line only with `// ds-allow: <reason>` and only when the colour genuinely cannot come from a token.
